name: Multibanco, MB WAY, Credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay, Direct Debit and Digital IBAN for WooCommerce – easypay
author: easypay

sections.description:
The official easypay plugin for WooCommerce. Offer your customers the most popular payment methods in Portugal through the easypay Checkout, and let the plugin update the order status (and stock) automatically once the payment is confirmed.

You can use a single easypay Checkout where the customer picks the payment method, or show each payment method separately in the WooCommerce checkout (“Multiple Checkout”).

Payment methods

  • Multibanco references
  • MB WAY
  • Visa & Mastercard credit and debit cards
  • Apple Pay
  • Google Pay
  • Samsung Pay
  • Direct Debit (SEPA)
  • Digital IBAN (bank transfer)

Only the payment methods contracted in your easypay account are shown to your customers.

Compatibility

  • WooCommerce 7.0 or later (tested up to 11.3)
  • WordPress 6.0 or later (tested up to 7.1)
  • PHP 7.4 or later (PHP 8.3+ recommended)
  • High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS / Custom Order Tables)
  • Classic checkout and the Cart/Checkout blocks
  • Translations included: English (US), English (UK) and Portuguese (Portugal)
  • Multilingual sites: WPML and Polylang
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin from Plugins → Add New.
  2. Go to easypay → Settings and enter the Connection Key of your store (easypay backoffice).
  3. Choose between the single easypay Checkout or one WooCommerce payment method per easypay method (Multiple Checkout).
  4. Full guide: https://www.easypay.pt/manual-woocommerce.
sections.faq:
How do I get started?

You need an easypay account. Then follow the WooCommerce integration guide on our website: https://www.easypay.pt/manual-woocommerce.

Samsung Pay does not show up at checkout

Samsung Pay is shown only when it is active in your easypay account and the plugin is in “Multiple Checkout” mode. After easypay activates it, link your store again in the easypay backoffice so the list of payment methods is updated.
sections.changelog:
1.3.2 (27/11/2026)

  • New plugin name, highlighting all the payment methods available to your customers
  • New: Samsung Pay
  • Improved post-payment experience: after paying by card, MB WAY, Apple Pay, Google Pay or Samsung Pay, customers go straight to a clean order confirmation
  • Improved checkout: only the payment methods active in your easypay account are shown
  • Your payment method settings are kept across plugin updates
  • The payment method name is always shown in orders and emails
  • Multilingual stores: WPML and Polylang support; Portuguese and English (UK) translations updated
  • Performance and security improvements
  • Compatible with WordPress 7.1, WooCommerce 11.3 and PHP 8.5

1.3.1 (26/06/2026)

  • Automatic redirect to the order-received page is now decided server-side and only for synchronous methods (card, MB WAY, Apple Pay, Google Pay), so the purchase event fires in Google Analytics / Google Ads / Meta without losing the payment instructions of deferred methods
  • Restored the order status update at checkout, so WooCommerce confirmation emails are sent
  • Better diagnostics when the checkout session cannot be created
  • Compatibility with WordPress 7.0

1.3.0 (14/05/2026)

  • New option in easypay → Settings to show each payment method with its logo only
  • Improved compatibility with the Cart/Checkout blocks and the classic checkout
  • Improved HPOS compatibility
  • easypay payment methods are available right after installation, without enabling each one
  • General stability improvements
  • Compatibility with WordPress 7.0 and WooCommerce 10.7

1.2.2 (14/05/2026)

  • Text domain aligned with the plugin slug
  • Central logger in WooCommerce → Status → Logs
  • Minimum/maximum amount per gateway
  • Accessibility improvements and security update

1.2.1

  • Order key validation
  • The cart is no longer emptied before payment
  • CSRF hardening
  • PHP 8.4 compatibility

1.2.0

  • easypay Checkout SDK 2.9.x
  • Compatibility with WordPress 6.9 and WooCommerce 10.7
  • Internal refactor, security improvements and PHP 8.x support

1.1.4 (05/03/2024)

  • Google Pay payments

1.1.2 (12/08/2024)

  • More validations and logs

1.1.1 (12/08/2024)

  • Order status can be set to on-hold or processing
  • Throttling to avoid excessive requests

1.1.0 (18/06/2024)

  • Checkout styling options

1.0.0 (21/02/2024)

  • Initial release with support for multiple payment methods.
